review.rationale: Same fiscal quarter (Q4) YoY comparison against the Q4 FY2024 baseline. Revenue fell from 12,606 to 11,097 USD million (−1,509 USD million, −12.0%). GAAP gross margin fell from 44.7% to 40.3% (−4.4 pp). Nike Brand digital YoY worsened from −10% to −26% (−16 pp). All three required metrics deteriorated materially in the same quarter, satisfying the thesis invalidation condition ("material same-quarter sales, margin, and digital-channel deterioration"). The recovery hypothesis is contradicted by the evidence.

Review complete. Summary of the research-state workflow for Case C03:

## Baseline (Q4 FY2024, SEC source `nike-2024-06-27-fy2024`)
- Revenue: 12,606 USD million
- Gross margin: 44.7%
- Nike Brand digital YoY: −10%

## Ingested event (Q4 FY2025, SEC source `nike-2025-06-26-fy2025`, sha256 `32e7d7c5…b7b3b8`)
- Revenue: 11,097 USD million
- Gross margin: 40.3%
- Nike Brand digital YoY: −26%

## Computed changes (same fiscal quarter, YoY)
| Metric | Q4 FY24 | Q4 FY25 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | 12,606 | 11,097 | −1,509 USD million (−12.0%) |
| Gross margin | 44.7% | 40.3% | −4.4 pp |
| Digital YoY | −10% | −26% | −16 pp |

All three required metrics (`quarterly_revenue`, `gross_margin`, `nike_brand_digital_yoy`) were present in the event packet, so no `needs_review` fallback was required.

## Decision
- **Impact:** negative
- **Decision:** invalidate
- **Status:** invalidated
- **Conviction:** 1

**Rationale:** All three required metrics deteriorated materially in the same fiscal quarter, satisfying the thesis's stated invalidation condition ("material same-quarter sales, margin, and digital-channel deterioration"). The recovery hypothesis is contradicted by the evidence.

## Ledger results
- Review recorded: `tr_430abe647b29491e95f9` (thesis version 1 → 2, `last_review_at` set).
- Alert `fa_bb2f760176eb4402ba64` acknowledged (version 1 → 2).

No trades or portfolio changes were made; this is research-state only.
